title: Cranberry Sauce
description: A bag of cranberries cooked down with sugar, orange juice, and the zest of a whole orange until the berries burst and set on their own pectin. Built off Priya Krishna's Bon Appétit sauce, with juice in the liquid, a splash of liquor, and citric acid on hand to dial the tartness.

notes: Whole batch (about 2 cups) split into 8 quarter-cup portions. Assumes all-white sugar at 150 g, and about 86 g of juice and 6 g of zest from one orange.
Optional liquor, nutmeg, cinnamon, citric acid, and salt are excluded. Light brown sugar barely moves the numbers.

items.note: about 150 g white or 165 g packed light brown; any mix of light brown and white
zested, then juiced; the zest is critical
with the orange juice: juice into the measuring cup, then top up with water to 1 cup
optional, about half a shot; white rum or brandy also work

directions.title: Prep
directions.text: Zest the orange, then juice it into a measuring cup and top up with water to 1 cup.

directions.title: Cook
directions.text: Into a medium saucepan over medium heat: 12 oz cranberries, ¾ cup sugar (any mix of light brown and white), the orange juice and water, the zest, a pinch of salt, 1–2 tbsp liquor if using, and a pinch of nutmeg and cinnamon if you want them. Stir often so it doesn't stick and scorch. Done when the berries have burst and it's jammy and coats a spoon, about 10 minutes.

directions.title: Careful
directions.text: Once it hits a simmer the cranberries start exploding and spitting molten sugar. It acts like napalm if it gets on your face, so keep your face back and stir at arm's length.

directions.title: Adjust and Cool
directions.text: Taste. If it needs more tang, stir in a little citric acid. Let it cool before serving; it sets up on the cranberries' own pectin, no thickener needed.

notes: Orange zest is critical. The rest is negotiable.
Keeps 5 days in an airtight container in the fridge, so make it ahead.

deviations.what: Juice of the orange as part of the 1 cup of liquid, and the zest of a whole orange instead of 1 tbsp
deviations.why: More orange all the way through, not just on top.

deviations.what: Light brown sugar, or a mix with white
deviations.why: The source allows it as a swap. This version just uses it by default.

deviations.what: Liquor is open: orange liqueur, white rum, or brandy
deviations.why: Optional. A splash of liquor adds a little flavor.

deviations.what: Optional pinch of nutmeg and cinnamon
deviations.why: A little warmth without burying the sharp cranberry bite. Krishna skips warm spice entirely.

deviations.what: Citric acid on hand to adjust
deviations.why: Tunes the tartness at the end without adding more liquid.
